_comment: Known gaps for failsafe Test 5 (asset-path integrity). Every entry needs a reason and an owner. Exact paths and invalid-JSON entries are stale-guarded: the test FAILS once they are fixed, so the fixing story must remove its entry.

missing_paths.reason: The Elder's dialogue portrait (data/dialogue/speakers.json): the Elder has no body yet, so the dialogue box draws the plate. Story 25.11 renders it with the portrait studio (scenes/dev/PortraitStudio.tscn, Story 25.17) and removes this entry.

The Bard's dialogue portrait (data/dialogue/speakers.json): the Bard has no body yet, so the dialogue box draws the plate. Story 25.12 renders it with the portrait studio (scenes/dev/PortraitStudio.tscn, Story 25.17) and removes this entry.

missing_prefixes.reason: Tarot art unfunded; demo uses class silhouettes (decision D-1, 2026-09-24)
